versions.content: Description of the required API argument data types Type: valid Description: Description of the actual data types required by the implementation for API function arguments which have been left open in the specification documents. Rationale: The specifications of the BSW modules in some cases do not fix the data type to be used for the implementation. To allow the integration these actually implemented data types need to be described. Dependencies: – Use Case: If the BSW SWS does specify an API argument to be either UInt8 or UInt16 the BSWMD template SHALL provide means to describe which type is expected in the actual implementation. Supporting Material: –
